{{< fa brands canadian-maple-leaf >}} I am a Data Analyst and Researcher based in Calgary, Alberta.

{{< fa regular scale-balanced >}} I am currently pursuing the Financial Risk Manager (FRM) designation.

{{< fa regular graduation-cap >}} I recently completed a Post-Baccalaureate in Data Analytics and Marketing at Okanagan College (Ranked #1 with GPA of 95%).

{{< fa regular money-bill-trend-up >}} I worked as a Research Officer at [CTS Global Equity Group](https://www.ctsglobalgroup.com/) from 2015 to 2021, focusing on market sentiment, risk management, and the fundamental and technical analyses of global equity markets.

{{< fa regular face-smile-beam >}} I enjoy traveling, food and sports.
